import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('tests/intelligence').resolve()))
from test_evidence_matching import source_job, candidate, assessed
from actual.job_intelligence.normalize import normalize_requirement
for text in ('5.5 years of experience are required.', 'Over five years of experience are required.', 'Five years of security experience are required.'):
    job=source_job(text)
    requirement=normalize_requirement(job,quote=text,term='experience',priority='essential')
    result=assessed(job,candidate(60,kind='experience',subject='experience',unit='months'),'experience')
    print({'quote':text,'assertion':requirement.assertion.model_dump(mode='json'),'fit':result.rows[0].status})
